subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu text commands (/stop, /new, /status) no longer bypass queue during active agent run (3.8 regression)

question: Should Feishu whole-message text slash commands beyond abort triggers, especially `/status` and `/new`, bypass the per-chat sequential queue during active runs and be marked as authorized `text-slash` command turns after channel access admission?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent fix changes the boundary between Feishu sender admission, command authorization, and session-state mutation during active runs.

options.title: Adopt Feishu-Scoped Text Command Contract
options.body: Mark authorized Feishu whole-message commands as text-slash turns and route only explicitly safe or immediate controls out of the ordinary same-chat lane, with `/new` handled by an explicit maintainer policy choice.

options.title: Keep Abort-Only Bypass
options.body: Leave `/status` and `/new` on the normal Feishu lane and document that only abort text bypasses active per-chat queueing.

options.title: Change Shared Command Policy
options.body: Move the text-command turn and authorization behavior into shared channel helpers, accepting the broader cross-channel security and compatibility review burden.

recommendation.title: Adopt Feishu-Scoped Text Command Contract
recommendation.body: Mark authorized Feishu whole-message commands as text-slash turns and route only explicitly safe or immediate controls out of the ordinary same-chat lane, with `/new` handled by an explicit maintainer policy choice.

likelyOwner.reason: The command authorization and command-turn history is the strongest signal for deciding this boundary.
